title_sq: Tek Kopshti Botanik, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Totalisht I Investuar !!!
description_sq: Tek Kopshti Botanik, ne Kompleksin Fratari shitet apartament 2+1+2 tualete + depo totalisht i investuar. Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 139 m2, neto 118.7 m2 , depo 6 m2 ndodhet ne katin e 2-te banim te nje pallati 4-katesh te mireadministruar me ashensor. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne korridorin i cili ben shperndarjen ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale, nje dhome per femije dhe dy tualete. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i investuar duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike dhe elektrike, sistem kondicionimi Chiller, parket teper cilesor, dritare dopioxham termike, mobilim cilesor dhe elektroshtepiake te markave me te njohura. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Lindje me pamje te lire nga Mali i Dajtit. Apartamenti disponon dhe nje garazh me siperfaqe 20 m2 me cmim extra 15.000 Euro. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti karakterizohet nga qetesi dhe ajri i paster qe ofron. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote Hipotekor.
title_en: Near the Botanical Garden, 2+1+2 Apartment for sale, Fully Invested!!!
description_en: At the Botanical Garden, in the Fratari Complex, an apartment for sale, 2+1+2 toilets + fully invested warehouse. The apartment with a total area of ​​139 m2, net 118.7 m2, storage room 6 m2 is located on the 2nd residential floor of a well-managed 4-story building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, a double bedroom, a children's room and two toilets. The apartment is fully invested, starting from the plumbing and electrical installations, Chiller air conditioning system, high quality parquet, thermal double-glazed windows, quality furniture and household appliances of the most popular brands. The orientation of the apartment is East with a clear view of Mount Dajt. The apartment also has a garage with an area of ​​20 m2 with an extra price of 15,000 Euros. The area in which the apartment is located is characterized by the peace and clean air it offers. The property has full mortgage documentation.
